name: open-weight models named by government evaluation bodies for cyber capability (as of November 2026)
rule: A model is listed once a government evaluation body publishes that it is the most cyber-capable open-weight model at release, or that it outperforms a model so named. Derivatives inherit the listing.

models.source: US CAISI, assessment of GLM-5.3's cyber capabilities, 17 September 2026
UK AISI with US CAISI, preliminary assessment of Kimi K3's cyber capabilities, 23 July 2026
US CAISI, assessment of GLM-5.2, 17 July 2026
